model_number: US (NTSC-U/C) PlayStation 2 single DVD keep case, black, Amaray-made (spine emboss 'US PAT No 5788068'), with memory-card holder
frame: Case closed, standing upright, front cover facing viewer (+Z), spine on the left (-X). X = width, Y = height, Z = thickness. Root = bottom-center of bbox: X in [-67.5, 67.5], Y in [0, 190], Z in [-7, 7]. Lid = front half (Z >= split plane), hinged to the spine at the spine-front edge; spine hinged to the base at the spine-back edge. Base = back half (Z <= split plane) holds hub, disc ring and memory-card holder. Positions on the base/lid inner faces are given in closed-case X/Y (and Z where 3D).

spine.hinge_type: double living hinge (PP) at both spine edges; modeled as two axes: CASE_SPINE (back hinge) and CASE_LID (front hinge, child of CASE_SPINE)
spine.inner_emboss: US PAT No 5788068 / EP PAT No 789348, JP No 2863317 (text, decorative)

layout.hinge_note: Both hinge lines run along Y on the outer spine corners (film side, where the PP living hinges are). Positive angle about hinge_axis_dir [0,-1,0] folds the part free edge toward +Z/-X. Model: CASE_SPINE (identity rest) sits under empty CASE_SPINE_HINGE at the back hinge, rotated pi about X so local +Y = world -Y; CASE_LID is a child of CASE_SPINE at the front hinge (local [0,0,-14] mm, zero rest rotation). rot_y pi/2 + pi/2 lays tray | spine | lid flat side by side, inner faces up, outer faces at Z = -7 (X -216.5 .. 67.5 = 284 mm).

disc_ring.note: segmented raised retaining arcs around the disc, finger-access gaps

memory_card_holder.size_note: build_case.py derives the pocket from fits_card_mm + 0.5 mm play (inner 57.0 x 42.5) with 1.2 mm bracket walls outside it (outer 59.4 x 44.9). The photo-scaled outline was 56.6 x 46.3, whose 54.2 mm inner length could not hold the 56.5 mm card.
memory_card_holder.emboss: PS logo + 'MEMORY CARD HOLDER' + left-pointing arrow

logo.frame: front face (+Z) of the insert, case X/Y mm; insert-top-left coords (x from spine edge, y from insert top) in brackets

ntsc_uc_tag.note: small 'NTSC U/C' box under banner right; not on every cover

spine_banner.frame: spine face (-X), positions as [Z, Y] mm; text reads top-to-bottom
spine_banner.greatest_hits_variant: band is red (#D0202A approx) with 'GREATEST HITS' text; not modeled by default

clips.on: lid inner face, at the lid free edge (+X side when closed)
clips.shape: flat tongue with rounded tip pointing toward the spine (-X), rooted in the free-edge wall

sleeve.covers: front + spine + back, open pockets at both free edges

insert_back_rect_mm.note: mirrored on the -Z face; x measured from the spine as seen from behind

notes: 190 x 135 from Wikipedia 'Keep case' (cites Amaray brochure) + coverstitch.io + Wii/Wii U keep-case 190x135x14 row; 14 mm = Amaray DVD single inlay spine (Amaray brochure, archived 2010: inlay 129.5 + 14 + 129.5 = 273 x 183, booklet max 120 x 180, up to 3 mm). US PS2 cover banner is BLACK with white 'PlayStation 2' wordmark left and color PS logo right (5 NA cover scans, banner 17.1 +-0.8 mm); the brief's 'white banner' is not what US covers show. Hub is below center (Y=71) because the memory-card holder occupies the top of the base; X offset -5 mm toward the spine from 2 photos (+-3 mm). Clips measured on PlayStation_2_Game_Case_-_Inside.jpg (6.0 px/mm from case height 190). Spine band from GameStop shelf photo (4.0 px/mm from case height). See PS2_Disc_Case/REFERENCE_NOTES.md.
